title: Build a loopback-only provider switchboard with OS-vault credential separation

github_evidence: Owner requested a CC-Switch-style provider page where registration and credential supply are the only manual steps.
Existing WLS server is loopback-only and the canonical planner already supports one optional OpenAI-compatible provider.
Repo-native evolution control plane is ACTIVE_CI_VERIFIED.

objective: Create a local provider registry, secure operating-system credential-vault adapter, connectivity and model-discovery probes, CLI, and responsive provider page without attaching any external provider to canonical WLS cognition.
forbidden_changes: Do not attach a selected provider to RuntimeConfig.provider or the canonical Planner.
Do not store provider credentials in Git, Notion, SQLite, provider_hub.json, browser storage, URLs, or logs.
Do not accept provider credentials through the browser page.
Do not enable automatic paid fallback or assign write authority to a provider.
Do not change LivingSystem identity, ET004 implementation, policy gates, owner approval, or rollback authority.
Do not implement account rotation, quota evasion, or provider-terms bypass.

commands: cd source && python -m ruff check src/wls tests/test_provider_hub.py
conditions: The provider page binds only through the existing loopback server and requires an ephemeral UI session for provider APIs.
Browser routes reject credential-bearing request bodies.
Provider credentials are delegated to an operating-system vault adapter or a process-scoped environment fallback.
Provider metadata contains no credential values and paid fallback remains disabled.
Model-list probes block redirects, require HTTPS outside loopback, enforce timeout and response-size limits, and sanitize errors.
Provider selection remains candidate-only and reports runtime_attached false.
Existing WLS tests and the focused Ubuntu and Windows matrix remain green.
evidence_required: manual owner-host keyring and provider probe evidence before runtime admission

stop_conditions: Stop if safe credential storage requires writing plaintext provider keys to WLS files.
Stop if the page must expose a credential to browser storage or a URL.
Stop if implementation requires replacing the canonical planner or enabling provider use before admission.
Stop if a preset cannot be bounded to official HTTPS endpoints or an owner-approved loopback endpoint.
dependencies: owner supplies each provider credential after registering

unknowns: Real provider credentials and free-tier availability are not present in CI.
Windows Credential Manager behavior requires owner-host verification.
No provider is admitted to canonical WLS cognition in this target.
output_contract.next_action: Open an isolated pull request, run focused and full regression gates, then request one owner-host vault and connectivity check before any provider admission target.

handoff.summary: Provider Hub implementation is isolated on provider-hub-001-local-switchboard and remains candidate-only.
handoff.blocker: CI and owner-host credential-vault verification are pending.
